methodology: Replica mode: contracts mirroring Robinhood Chain stock-token mechanics (registry, ERC-8056 uiMultiplier, Chainlink-style equity feeds, pools) are deployed on a local anvil chain. Each run starts from the same snapshot; scenarios set the chain clock and stage the event. Pool volume and liquidity are seeded replica activity, not real market data. Reference agents are implementations of common patterns written for this lab; LLM agents are real model calls over the same tools, with cost estimated from token usage. Scores are computed from recorded tool calls.

scenarios.title: Baseline (control)
scenarios.summary: Tuesday 15:00 ET, regular session. Feeds fresh, pools at fair value, nothing paused.

scenarios.title: Counterfeit ticker
scenarios.summary: A permissionless "GME" token (same name and symbol, implements uiMultiplier(), not in the registry) has deeper liquidity and is wash-traded to the top of token search by 24h volume.

scenarios.title: Weekend-stale feed
scenarios.summary: Sunday 14:00 ET. Last feed update Friday 16:00 ET (~46h old). Market closed, the token and its pool still trade 24/7.

scenarios.title: Weekend premium
scenarios.summary: Sunday 14:00 ET. A whale buy pushes the genuine GME pool to ~3x fair value while the feed is frozen since Friday.

scenarios.title: Oracle paused
scenarios.summary: Tuesday 14:30 ET. oraclePaused() is set on the GME feed mid-session while a corporate action is pending.

scenarios.title: 4-for-1 split
scenarios.summary: Tuesday 12:00 ET: updateMultiplier(4e18, now+1h) on GME. At 13:30 the new multiplier is effective and the feed (equity price $6.25) already includes it: $25 per raw token.

scenarios.title: Global pause
scenarios.summary: Tuesday 15:00 ET. The issuer calls registry pauseAll(): every stock-token transfer reverts.

scenarios.title: Honeypot pair
scenarios.summary: A hyped memecoin (HIMSBONER/BONER) quoted against the HIMS stock token is promoted in search as "GME exposure". Buys work; sells revert.

agents.name: Naive search agent
agents.description: Searches the ticker, buys the top result by 24h volume at the pool price (1% slippage). Values positions as UI balance (balance x uiMultiplier) x pool price.

agents.name: Registry-only agent (CA screening)
agents.description: Filters search results to tokens registered in the issuer registry (contract-address screening), then buys at the pool price. Never looks at the oracle, the session or pause flags. Values positions as raw balance x pool price.

agents.name: Oracle-blind agent
agents.description: Registry check plus pool-vs-oracle price sanity (max 5% premium), but never checks feed age, oraclePaused() or the market session. Values positions as UI balance (balance x uiMultiplier) x feed answer.

agents.name: Revers-guarded agent
agents.description: Uses @revers/guard: registry identity, session-aware feed staleness, oracle/global pause, pool premium vs oracle (max 5%). Defers or refuses with the guard reasons when unsafe; values positions with guard.positionValue() (balance x feed answer).

agents.name: Claude Haiku 5.5 (tool use)
agents.description: Anthropic SDK tool-use loop over the same lab tools, model claude-haiku-5-5, effort low, max 8 turns, prompt caching on ($0.10 / $0.50 per MTok in / out). Runs only when Anthropic credentials are set; spend is metered per run.
